primaryEvidence.observed: Documentation describes anonymous filtered CSV table exports, 5,000 current-view and 25,000 extended-view caps, interactive repeated export support, one-month registration lag and unpublished confidential fields.
Legal notice item 4 explicitly licenses .xls/.csv data and webservice data under dl-de/by-2-0 unless otherwise marked; other uses require prior written approval.
Inspected native German unit/AGS/status/capacity/date/organization/operator-ID column titles and interactive CSV modal. Empty server-rendered grid is not evidence of zero units.

Deleted/deactivated native view includes unit ID, last operating status, system status, update and deletion reason, but no AGS. Documentation states these erroneous/duplicate entries are not registered.

Natural-person data and solar-unit locations up to 30 kWp are confidential; organizations can also be registered under natural-person confidentiality. Public accidental disclosure is not permission to expand private-person ingestion.

Read-only detail inspection establishes native SEE/ABR prefixes, separate commissioning/registration dates and solar gross kWp versus net kW. Its contents are not fixture data and do not cover a pilot town.

admission.requiredInput: Exact admitted original bytes plus sourceSha256 and policyReceiptSha256. The adapter checks byte/hash binding, official HTTPS origin and scope; it does not replace the acquisition rights engine or create a licence/admission receipt.
admission.csvAndXls: dl-de/by-2-0 is documentation evidence, subject to distribution-specific contrary markings, attribution, publicness, personal-data minimization and current policy. Attribution must identify Bundesnetzagentur/Marktstammdatenregister, source and licence; modifications/mappings must be disclosed.
admission.unknownRights: held_origin; an official host/link alone is not admission
admission.bulkXmlZip: held_origin; unresolved distribution-specific rights, excluded from this adapter
admission.soap: blocked_access; no authenticated SOAP route, account/key acquisition or technical-user association
admission.network: No acquisition, network, subprocess, provider call or implicit current-clock read inside discover or parse. Discovery consumes an already admitted fetched landing. Each newly discovered resource requires separate admission.

csv.profile: Native German public electricity-generation export headers; semicolon delimiter, UTF-8/BOM or explicitly labelled windows-1252/ISO-8859-1; quoted fields and embedded separators handled by shared readCsv.
csv.limits: 16 MiB input; 25,000 data rows; 128 columns; one export slice is never whole-town completeness

xlsSpreadsheetMl.profile: Excel 2003 SpreadsheetML workbook through shared readSpreadsheetXml, only when the admitted distribution is an XLS file. Native string IDs, raw numeric/date cell types and sheet/cell addresses retained. This is a parser capability, not a claim that the publisher emits this XLS profile.
xlsSpreadsheetMl.security: No DTD/entities, formulas, external retrieval or execution; bounded shared reader

xlsBinaryBiff.reason: No inspected/admitted binary XLS distribution or supported BIFF profile; documented native CSV is the primary route. Do not count BIFF as operational.

xlsx.reason: Not implied licensed by the literal .xls/.csv legal notice; no invented XLSX distribution or admission.

MaStR-Nr. der Einheit.meaning: Native electricity-unit identity, separate from EEG/KWK plant IDs, registration number and actor ID; durable identity is not the label.

Gemeindeschlüssel.meaning: Eight-digit AGS string including leading zeroes; exact native field only, project_location. No postcode/name join, district allocation or numeric zero-padding.

Betriebs-Status.meaning: Attributed register operating-status label; preserved literally, not coerced to final completion, approval or measured generation.

Bruttoleistung der Einheit.meaning: Rated gross capacity; solar kWp based on the explicit solar energy-carrier field, other electricity units kW. Raw field and energy-carrier evidence retained; not actual generation.

Nettonennleistung der Einheit.meaning: Rated net capacity in kW; not interchangeable with solar gross kWp.

Nutzbare Speicherkapazität in kWh.meaning: Usable storage energy capacity in kWh, not generation or rated power.

Inbetriebnahmedatum der Einheit.meaning: Sourced commissioning date, not registration, publication, planning or ownership date.

Inbetriebnahmedatum der Einheit am aktue.meaning: Separate site-commissioning date, not necessarily the original commissioning date.

Registrierungsdatum der Einheit.meaning: Registration date only; never commissioning or ownership.

Datum der geplanten Inbetriebnahme.meaning: Planned commissioning date only; no operation claim.

Datum der endgültigen Stilllegung.meaning: Permanent decommissioning date; separate from deletion/deactivation of an erroneous registration.

Letzte Aktualisierung.meaning: Native record version/raw expression and sourceReferenceDate. Not publication date or validFrom of an operator relationship. Missing publication/version dates remain null.

MaStR-Nr. des Anlagenbetreibers.meaning: Retain an explicit publicly disclosed ID only together with a non-redacted organization-only name. ID-only/organization-redacted rows are unknown and the pseudonymous ABR is excluded from observations and evidence. No name-based operator identity. Registered organization operator ID is not ownership or independent legal-entity verification.

Name des Anlagenbetreibers (nur Org.).meaning: Only with a valid public ABR ID and non-redacted organization-only field: registered operator identifier, source-attributed OrganizationObservation and actor operates unit. ID-only rows emit operator_disclosure null without ABR or organization/operates evidence. Names without IDs and redacted/missing operators remain unknown. Contacts, asset labels, addresses, natural-person identities and private fields are not ingested.

withdrawnView.meaning: Native deleted/deactivated view lacks AGS; rows stay unassigned with partial coverage pending an admitted prior-version municipality join. They do not remove every town's unit or infer municipal deletion. A missing unit in any partial/empty export is never a tombstone.

workbookDateBoundary: SpreadsheetML calendar-string and native DateTime dates are supported. Numeric date cells remain held_quality even when a helper identifies a date style: the current source contract lacks original number-format and workbook date-system evidence locators. No Excel serial date is interpreted from column name or style classification alone.
temporalSemantics: An exported operator relationship is an attributed as-observed assignment with unknown effective interval; retrievedAt and record update do not establish present validity. Current graph traversal must apply the shared temporal admission contract and cannot promote this alone to confirmed-current operation.

evidence.verification: Deterministic cell mapping; no invented prose quotations, model IDs, judge score or LLM receipt

discovery.behavior: Official same-host HTTPS advertised .csv/.xls and known public unit-overview links only; preserve query selectors. No guessed API/download URLs, onclick execution, interactive modal promotion to GET or bulk dump references.
discovery.pagination: 32 sorted advertised resources per local discovery page; cursor binds exact source bytes and entire source/municipality/tenant/window scope. This is adapter-local pagination, not claimed publisher export pagination.
discovery.completion: Always partial or not_checked for public landings; a CSV slice does not encode all filters, export total, cap position or exhausted successor pages.

observed: Primary documentation and public landing/header inspection
unverified: Live CSV download selectors, session/anti-forgery flow and export bytes
Synthetic test execution and TypeScript integration

questionBoundaries.E03: Conditional public operator-ID route only; redacted/ID-only operator rows cannot establish shared legal organizations. Independent identity/ownership evidence remains required.
questionBoundaries.E05: Commissioning and rated capacity are not measured generation, municipal ownership or asset-outcome evidence.
questionBoundaries.W04: MaStR electricity-unit operators do not establish actual heat-network operators; remains unaddressed by this adapter.

fixtures.provenance: Synthetic native-format bytes using inspected official column titles; not acquired real exports or verified pilot facts

integrationChecks: Shared structured-tables tests and full adapter integration suite
Verify publication preserves structured provenance, public-organization role and unknown effective validity without inferred ownership/generation
